changes: Applicable Mooneye acceptance doubled from 33/66 in v1.3.0 to 66/66: +50 percentage points and +100% more passing tests.
Measured median core throughput improved 33.25% for DMG and 17.83% for GBC in the frozen seven-trial, 1,000-frame release benchmark.
CPU bus cycles, interrupts, timers, serial, OAM DMA corruption, HDMA, PPU mode timing, STOP, speed switching, and CGB registers now model many more hardware edge cases.
The APU now has hardware-timed channel state, length/envelope/sweep quirks, wave RAM behavior, exact sample integration, and sample-rate-correct analog coupling.
Audio playback now uses bounded interpolated clock correction, clean underrun recovery, four real latency targets, and a repaired low-latency fallback path.
MBC1 multicarts, MBC2, MBC3 RTC-only carts, MBC5 rumble banking, save-state compatibility, serial-link hooks, infrared hooks, and conformance tooling were expanded.
